Title: Sprunki
Description:
Sprunki Incredibox Original – Create your own melody using a combination of different sounds!
Dive into the world of Sprunki Incredibox Original, where music comes to life right before your eyes and creative freedom knows no bounds. Create your own melodies with the charismatic Sprunki characters!  Game Features: 🎼 Unlimited musical possibilities: Discover hundreds of sound combinations that are perfect for you.  🧩 Complete creative freedom: Play your way—no restrictions, just mix and experiment.  🌟 Find the best combinations: Choose the ideal rhythms and melodies to craft your unique musical style.  🎧 Engaging and relaxing: Perfect for laid-back gameplay and inspiring musical experimentation.  In Sprunki Incredibox Original, everything is simple and fun: drag characters, mix rhythms, and create tracks with no limits. You are the composer, and each sound combination is your own unique musical masterpiece.
Instructions:
If you don't have sound on your iPhone, enable notifications with the special button on your phone❗️  
🎵 Choose a sound: Each character has their own unique sound. Simply drag a character from the bottom onto any Sprunki to add their sound to your mix. 
 🎶 Combine Sprunkis to create a harmonious and captivating melody. Experiment and enjoy the process!  
✨ Find the secret scene: Try different character combinations to unlock hidden mixes and receive bonus effects!

Title: Playground Man! Ragdoll Show!
Description:
🌟 Welcome to the world of destruction and puzzles with ragdoll physics, where the wooden stickman is already waiting for your help! Immerse yourself in a physical playground full of destruction and relax, solving interesting puzzles.

A great free game for all fans of physics puzzles and ragdoll simulators. If you are a fan of such legendary games as Ragdoll Break: Let's destroy! and Kick Master, then you have come to the right place. Here you will find many exciting adventures with a ragdoll stickman!

🔥 Game features:
- Exciting levels with a variety of tasks that require creative solutions
- Funny ragdoll physics of destruction and interaction with objects of the world
- Compete in global leaderboards: show your best results and defeat other players.
- Play online from any device. Enjoy destruction on your smartphone or PC at any time.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Support us by leaving a short review. Your opinion will help us improve the game!
Instructions:
Looking for a relaxing casual 3D game with ragdoll physics? Solve puzzles and unlock new levels. 

🎯Your task: solve puzzles by controlling a stickman or other objects on the level.

🕹️To control, simply move your finger across the screen on a mobile phone or use the mouse with the left mouse button held down on a PC

Title: Slides And Climbs
Description: Slides And Climbs is a laid-back online game based on the traditional English board game of the same name, which served as an inspiration for the American version known as Chutes and Ladders. This beloved classic board game can be played for free in single-player mode or with friends locally. Roll the dice and navigate your way to the finish line. Let’s hope you avoid landing on a snake!
Instructions: You have the option to play with as many as six players, where each player can choose their own color. Roll the dice to advance your piece, and rolling a 6 gives you an additional free roll. You can enjoy Slides And Climbs with a maximum of six friends or choose to compete against AI opponents.

Title: Makeup Fruits
Description:
Have you ever imagined giving a watermelon a makeover? How about adding a flutter of eyelashes or a swipe of lipstick to a juicy melon? In Makeup Fruits, your mission is to help these delightful fruits dazzle with beauty. It's all in your hands to adorn them with the perfect makeup and accessories for their stunning transformation!

Click to select the fruit you want to transform into a beauty icon, then proceed to choose and apply a variety of makeup options. Explore a diverse selection of brands, powder colors, eyelashes, lipsticks, stickers, and more!

At the end, you'll be able to take a "selfie" of your fabulous creation to share with your friends.

You'll also earn "gems" as a reward for your work. These gems can be used to unlock exciting new items and keep the fun going!
Instructions: Use your mouse to select a fruits and then drag and drop makeup headbands, select lipstick, eye colors and many many other components to create a beautiful Makeup Fruit!

Title: Fun Toy Pals
Description: Step into a cozy playroom and explore a world full of charming toys! In this addictive merge game, your goal is to combine matching toys on the colorful carpet to create higher-level toys. Unlock achievements as you reach higher scores and compete with players around the world on the global leaderboard. Cute visuals, fun combinations, and endless merging challenges make this game perfect for casual gamers of all ages.
Instructions:
Combine toys of the same type by dragging them onto each other to create a new, higher-level toy. The more you merge, the higher your score! Complete achievements to unlock special rewards and climb the leaderboard to become the ultimate toy master.

Desktop Controls:
Mouse: Click and drag toys to merge them.

Mobile Controls:
Touch: Tap and drag toys to merge them.
